text.tspan: I am a Computer Science undergraduate who enjoys building practical software, backend systems,
full-stack applications, and AI-powered solutions. My work spans placement automation, AI
meeting assistance, demand forecasting, and robotics.
I am currently strengthening my skills in Python, backend development, data structures and
algorithms, databases, and AI/ML. I am seeking software development internships and full-time
